scope: Approved wave foundation corrected with recurring aligned grids, soft light forms and genuine low flight; room/login/SAO/boost stay retired
entry: One guarded direct Start; decoded sample zero; no visual age offset
clock: AudioTransport.visualPosition using output timestamp estimate or graph fallback; zero external calibration offset
background: Mostly black sky; slow dark section-led horizon plus world-space near/mid/far stars

geometry.depth_surface: 144x168 centered canonical lattice, 47762 black triangles; all-heading radial light fade 155-198 m before the shortest floor-window edge
geometry.emitters: Once-locked canonical origins introduced 1.5 song-seconds before each selective event; shared by visible emitters, CPU/GLSL fronts, picking and support
geometry.wave: Gaussian radial fronts from selected candidate event centres; 34 units/s, width 10, attack .14s, lifetime 5.6s, final fade 1.4s
geometry.bound: 14*tanh(sum/14): analytic |height|<14; GPU float rounding can reach 14. Reduced-mode gain .3.
geometry.colour: white, local wash and held limited palette; 2.5s smooth crossfades. Held palette and base coverage constant; beat lights and waves continue.

camera.lateral_limit: none: heading changes the actual travelled path
camera.guide: Barycentric height of rendered grid triangles, 12-unit lookahead, damped follow 2.4/s plus positive-clearance guard
camera.reduced_motion: Freeze x/z/yaw, suppress tilt/bank/overview; no catch-up on release; wave amplitude .3; star emission .3
camera.webgl_restore: Restore camera/input-mode state; audio remains paused until deliberate resume
camera.eye_gap_gpu_note: 3.2-unit CPU guard; sampled GPU/CPU kernel error recorded separately. Not a physical near-plane/device certification.
camera.overview: One C2 96 m additional lift 158–162 s, return 171–177 s; route advances continuously; reduced mode skips lift
camera.seek_policy: Explicit developer seek reconstructs labelled nominal no-input route; context snapshots retain interactive path/input history/fixed origins
camera.integration: Midpoint-filtered input and exact constant-rate planar arc in <=1/240 song-second substeps; ordinary stalls integrate rather than reset

rendering.output: Linear half-float 4x MSAA RenderPass -> quarter-size separable Gaussian -> spatial composite -> OutputPass once
rendering.halos: Local radial halos; .13 spatial soft mix plus .055 blurred light; no temporal smear and no blur on DOM
rendering.unresolved_lights: Fade by projected core diameter and distance; do not force bright horizon pixels
rendering.antialiasing: 4x composer target MSAA; default framebuffer antialias false, no redundant MSAA
rendering.materials: Original unlit additive gradient light shells; no PMREM, environment maps, physical transmission, clearcoat or light rigs

timing_status: Numerically filtered candidates; 255 events. No approved BPM or beats.
pulse_track: show/light-pulses.json: separate numerically fitted local-phase candidates plus selective quiet accents; no approved BPM/beats/listening
current_scope_note: Historical grid-flight record; current visual authority is show/global-lightshow.as-built.json and clearance.as-built.json. Physical waves, original transport and flight remain preserved.
